authority: original primary 5-fold remains selection authority; alternate splits diagnostic only
algorithm: SHA256 of literal prefix, fixed seed, historical duplicate group representative modulo 5

bootstrap.metric: exact pair-count weighted time-stratified AUC per fold, arithmetic mean of five folds

historical_regime.standardize: DEV historical descriptor mean/std; clip standardized descriptors to [-8,8]
historical_regime.clustering: KMeans algorithm lloyd; deterministic single-thread fit
historical_regime.stress: leave one cluster out, train four; global H-only grouping is transductive diagnostic

mechanism.mixed_rule: two or more threshold-normalized effects >=1 and largest <1.5 times second largest
mechanism.weak_rule: insufficient windows or every normalized effect <1
mechanism.dominant_rule: largest normalized effect otherwise; deterministic order mean, scale, dependence, tail

new_generation.clear_robustness_gain: all 3 alternate deltas nonnegative and alternate mean >=0.0015; regime worst nonworse
new_generation.independent_mechanism_gain: matched ablation of a new statistic has primary mean delta >=0.001 and improves at least one supported mechanism by >=0.003
